verdict.rationale: Pilot's FAQ says it can provide consolidated reporting for US entities with foreign subsidiaries, and its pricing page lists custom reporting. That is one thin, scoped claim, delivered as a managed service rather than a tool the accountant operates directly. Missing for 10: documentation of managing multiple legal entities (entity setup, intercompany eliminations, per-entity books), consolidation scenarios beyond US-parent/foreign-subsidiary structures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
